4.Sub-event_summary: The VIII Corps is designated to lead the U.S. First Army offensive southward along the Cotentin west coast, aiming to advance twenty miles to secure high ground near Coutances and form a new army line to Caumont. The plan involves sequential attacks by adjacent corps, with VIII Corps facilitating the advance by threatening enemy flanks. The corps targets key terrain around la Haye-du-Puits, including hills and ridges, using three divisions in a V-shaped thrust, with specific objectives assigned to each division, and plans for the 8th Division to replace the 82d Airborne.

10.Sub-event_summary: XIX Corps to contain east of Vire, support VII Corps; V Corps diversionary attack D+2. VII Corps modifications: added 4th Infantry Division to assault (due to 9th/30th exhaustion); rerouted exploitation—1st Infantry (with 3d Armored CCB) direct to Coutances; reduced 3d Armored wider envelopment; 2d Armored (with 4th Division's 22d RCT) to left blocking at le Mesnil-Herman/Villebaudon/Tessy-sur-Vire and Cérences, providing VIII Corps corridor.
